text:
dave_acme: Heads up — our production Dedicated pool (acme-prod-us-east) started returning 429s at ~2025-10-20T09:16:00Z. Clients show `X-Redwood-Pool: shared-fallback` in responses even though we have capacity reserved. Request IDs: req_0a1b, req_0a1c. Can we get help? :frowning:

alice_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a sample response header + pool id and your account id? Also any recent config changes?

dave_acme: account_id: acct-ACME123
pool: acme-prod-us-east
sample response headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Throttled
X-Request-ID: req_0a1b
X-Redwood-Pool: shared-fallback
X-RateLimit-Reason: controlplane_routing_fallback
```
No config changes on our side.

alice_support: Thanks. Tagging runtime and SRE. @ben_runtime @carol_sre :eyes:

ben_runtime: Looking at control-plane routing logs for acct-ACME123 around 09:15Z. I see route decision entries where policy evaluation falls through because `tier` label didn't match: expected `reserved`, saw `reserved ` (trailing space) for acme-prod-us-east. That's causing the router to treat it as non-matching and fall back to shared pool.

carol_sre: Ugh. That explains the wrong pool selection. Is this from a recent rollout of the routing normalizer? Any quick repro?

ben_runtime: Repro steps:
1) `redwoodctl routes eval --account acct-ACME123 --model gpt-mini --headers 'x-customer-tier:reserved'`
2) control-plane returns `match: false` when pool label contains extra whitespace

Example log snippet:
```
[2025-10-20T09:15:12Z] route_eval acct=acct-ACME123 decision=NO_MATCH pool=acme-prod-us-east labels={"tier":"reserved "}
[2025-10-20T09:15:12Z] route_eval acct=acct-ACME123 decision=FALLBACK pool=shared-fallback reason=label_mismatch
```

ben_runtime: Root cause: a trimming bug in the new label-serializer. Will prepare a hotfix. For immediate mitigation, you can pin via header or set `route_override`:
```
X-Redwood-Force-Pool: acme-prod-us-east
```
or create a stricter route that matches by `pool_id`.

alice_support: Escalating to eng-runtime. Filing ticket RN. @ben_runtime can you add repro and the log snippet to the ticket? I'll relay mitigations to the customer.

dave_acme: Thanks, we'll apply the header as a temporary workaround. Any ETA for the fix?

ben_runtime: I'll cut a patch and request an urgent deploy. ETA ~2 hours assuming tests pass. I'll post PR and deploy notes here. :thumbsup:

routing-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-8469 assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: high. Link: https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2025-8469

carol_sre: After patch we should run smoke tests across pools to verify no other label variants exist. Also add a unit test for trimming. I'll own rollout verification.

alice_support: Noted. Dave — I'll follow up once eng confirms deploy. If you see more 429s after the header, ping here and we'll open a live debugging session.

dave_acme: Will do. Thanks everyone. :pray:
